ceiling_rule: Any new temporal-control fit reaching epoch 5000 invalidates final aggregation until the optimization budget is revisited using train/validation only.
difference_definition: For RMSE/MAE, comparator minus causal GCN; positive values favor causal GCN.
feature_policy: Same 20 voltage/current within-cycle statistical features used in the clean feature-matched benchmark.
inferential_sensitivity: Exact two-sided paired sign-flip tests over the five split-level differences are sensitivity analyses, not claims of five fully independent datasets.

causal_gcn.temporal_operation: two causal parameter-free mean aggregation steps with maximum receptive field {t,t-1,t-2}

kalman_q0p01_mlp.temporal_operation: independent causal local-level Kalman filter per feature

lowpass_binomial3_mlp.temporal_operation: strictly causal normalized FIR taps [1,2,1] over {t-2,t-1,t}

moving_average3_mlp.temporal_operation: strictly causal trailing moving average, window=3

savgol5_poly2_mlp.temporal_operation: one-sided causal endpoint polynomial smoother, window=5, polyorder=2

multiple_testing_policy: For each error metric, Holm-adjust the GCN-vs-control sign-flip p-values across all planned control-by-domain comparisons.
new_fit_count_definition: 4 new controls x 5 split seeds x 3 initialization seeds
planned_analysis: Average three initialization seeds within each split_seed, then compare methods at the five split-level repeated-holdout units. Report paired differences and win/loss counts.
preprocessing_pipeline_new_controls: strictly causal filtering within each cell
filter-specific secondary standardization fitted using training cells only
primary_replication_policy: Three initialization seeds are averaged within each split_seed. The five split_seed units remain the higher-level repeated-split comparison units.
raw_mlp_identity_policy: The frozen clean final_v3 raw MLP is reused rather than retrained. The preprocessing audit demonstrated that the identity secondary transform has mean 0 and variance 1 to numerical precision, so a second identity standardization is redundant.
reference_fit_count_definition: 15 frozen raw MLP fits + 15 frozen causal GCN fits from clean final_v3
research_question: Determine whether the causal graph model's behavior can be explained by generic causal temporal smoothing rather than graph-specific message passing.
sequence_model_note: A TCN/sequence baseline is reserved for a separate pre-specified protocol after the classical causal smoothing benchmark.
test_policy: New temporal-control fits may evaluate the held-out test cells only after model training and validation early stopping are complete. Test results cannot change filtering parameters, scalers, architecture, optimization settings, patience, or epoch ceiling.
